sous_titre: Croissance annuelle du marché mondial des équipements de transport optique, en pourcentage, 2024 à 2026

2024.texte: the Optical Transport market is forecast to return to growth in 2025 after declining 9 percent in 2024

2025.texte: the Optical Transport equipment market grew 10 percent in 2025, driven by demand for data center interconnect (DCI)

2026 (prévision).texte: the Optical Transport equipment market is forecast to grow 16 percent in 2026, surpassing $18 billion in manufacturer revenue
